simple.meaning: אָמוֹן (ʼÂmôwn) appears 17 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.

timeline.evidenceText: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son.
Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.
But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.
He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.
He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.
But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

definitions.full: H526. Amon אָמִי proper name, masculine Ezra 2:57 +? אָמוֺן Neh 7:59 . III. אָמוֺן proper name, masculine ( master-workman ) ( a ) king of Judah 2Kin 18:19 , 23 , 24 , 25 ; 1Chr 3:14 ; 2Chr 33:20-21 , 22 , 23 , 25 ; Jer 1:2 ; 25:3 ; ( b ) captain of a city 1Kin 22:26 ; 2Chr 18:25 ; ( c ) one of the line of Solomon's servants Neh 7:59 = אָמִי Ezra 2:57 .
